verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say the Solo 2 works driverless in any USB port, offers NFC tap-to-authenticate on compatible Android and iOS devices, and supports the passkey/WebAuthn standard. Together these imply broad cross-OS and cross-browser use, but none of it is documented explicitly. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported operating systems and browsers, a published compatibility catalog of supported services, and independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-platform behavior.
